tradition_assertions.notes: The EOTC English list names 'Book of Joshua the Son of Sirac' at entry 45, and the archive indexes Sirach/Ecclesiasticus as a candidate title. This establishes a title-level research connection only, not identity between the English Brenton Septuagint text, a Geʽez witness, or a current Church edition.

additional_notes: The local parser checks the member checksum, 51 ordered USFM chapter divisions (1–51), 1,368 source-numbered labels, one unnumbered continuation, the chapter-1 prologue heading and labels 1a–1g, source paragraph/break markers, and the chapter-1 omission gaps. eBible.org's index includes a page numbered 0, but that page contains only the prologue heading; the prologue text is on its page 1 and within USFM chapter 1, so no verse-bearing chapter is omitted or invented. These are digital-source structure checks only, not collation against the 1851 print edition or Greek source. Accuracy and printed-edition completeness remain unverified. The title-level relationship to EOTC entry 45 remains uncertain, and it is not counted as an EOTC canon reader or toward canon reader coverage.
